$comment: Provenance for every externally sourced capability. Twenty skills were already present in .github/skills when this registry was created; they are recorded as pre-existing rather than claimed as reviewed, because no security review of them has been performed by this system. Agents recommend; the operator installs.

skills.name: pre-existing .github/skills set
skills.note: Inventoried and mapped to agents in AGENT-SETUP.md. Auditing them with the audit-skills skill is open work, not a completed check.
